title: Delta payload, package format version 1
description: Structure only: required and forbidden members, types, enumerations, string patterns, and length and count limits. A document this schema accepts can still be refused by the engine, because the engine's relational and time-based rules cannot be expressed here; the Python validator in public_pilot is authoritative. Not expressed here: base_sha256 must equal the hash of the installed edition and result_sha256 the hash of the result; package_id must match the base; the result must be a valid snapshot payload that changes the edition ID, advances publication and keeps the cutoff from moving backwards. Authoritative: public_pilot.packages.resolve_chain.
$comment: Patterns end in $(?!\n) so that regular-expression engines whose $ also matches before a final newline still require a whole-string match. JSON Schema counts 1.0 as an integer; the engine requires integer literals.
